## How it works

- [statement] ggml-metal batches matrix multiplication and activation kernels into Metal command buffers, but host-device barrier synchronization causes pipeline stalls if intermediate outputs are queried synchronously. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/blob/master/ggml/src/ggml-metal.metal · keywords: GGML Metal Kernel Dispatch and Command Buffer Offload · also: https://developer.apple.com/metal/

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Pre-compiling Metal pipeline state objects and caching shader functions avoids runtime compilation pauses during initial context evaluation. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/blob/master/ggml/src/ggml-metal.metal · keywords: GGML Metal Kernel Dispatch and Command Buffer Offload · also: https://developer.apple.com/metal/
